summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing it will report second quarter 2026 financial results before market open on August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call and webcast at 8:00 AM ET. The release includes a statement from the CEO regarding his first 100 days and the upcoming earnings presentation. No specific financial data, transaction terms, or structural changes are disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement and does not constitute any special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change. The registrant is the issuer making a periodic financial update. There are no deal terms to report.
